intro: Convert milliliters (mL) to UK Imperial fluid ounces (fl oz UK) accurately for British recipes, pub pours, beverage cans, and Commonwealth kitchen measures. Under the UK Weights and Measures standard, 1 Imperial fluid ounce equals exactly 28.4130625 mL (1/160 of an Imperial gallon), so 1 mL equals 0.03519508 fl oz (UK)—just divide milliliters by 28.41306. Scan common pour sizes from 4 mL to 1,000 mL below.

items: A UK Imperial fluid ounce (28.41306 mL, 1/20 of a 568 mL UK pint) is 4.1% smaller than a US fluid ounce (29.57353 mL, 1/16 of a 473 mL US pint); verify whether your recipe uses British or American cups and pints.
Fluid ounces measure liquid volume, not weight/mass (dry avoirdupois ounces = 28.3495 g). Only water has nearly a 1:1 ratio between grams and milliliters.

faqs.question: How many UK Imperial fluid ounces are in 1 milliliter?
faqs.answer: There are 0.035195 UK Imperial fluid ounces in 1 milliliter (1 ÷ 28.4130625 = 0.03519508 fl oz UK). Conversely, 1 UK fluid ounce equals 28.4130625 mL.

faqs.question: How do I convert mL to UK fluid ounces?
faqs.answer: Divide the volume in milliliters by 28.4130625 (or multiply by 0.03519508): fl oz (UK) = mL ÷ 28.4130625. For example, 500 mL ÷ 28.4130625 = 17.59754 fl oz (UK).

faqs.question: What is the difference between UK Imperial fluid ounces and US fluid ounces?
faqs.answer: 1 UK Imperial fluid ounce equals 28.41306 mL (1/20 of a 568 mL UK pint), whereas 1 US fluid ounce equals 29.57353 mL (1/16 of a 473 mL US pint). That makes 100 mL equal to 3.52 UK fl oz or 3.38 US fl oz.

faqs.question: What is 750 mL in UK fluid ounces?
faqs.answer: 750 milliliters equals 26.39631 UK Imperial fluid ounces (about 26.4 fl oz UK).
